g.text: I spilled bubble tea on my PC pls tell me you got this message so I know everything works
omg thank all the gods. Amir would never have let me live that down
What kind of tea did you say it was?
And just how did you spill tea all over your PC?
bubble tea! it's a milky tea with chewy little tapioca pearls
ok don't make fun of me
So little of what you just said made sense to me, but I trust your taste.
I didn't have room on my desk so I sat my drink on the tower. then I was settling in, getting comfy
You seem upset. Is it something I said?
when I crossed my legs, my knee hit the bubble tea and BAM. Tea EVERYWHERE. Not a drop left in the cup!
Do you still have a few sips left at least?
And this stuff nearly broke your PC?
The weirdest part of that story was when you sat cross-legged at a computer desk.
I'm having a really hard time not making fun of you right now.
I'll spare you the lecture about caring for your electronics.
I didn't love being called boring.
Oh. I really didn't mean anything by it.
pity meee! I only got like one sip and bubble tea's tough to come by around here!
No chance of getting another tea from wherever you got that one then?
Okay, fair enough. That sucks. Silver lining is you didn't break anything though, right?
Honest. I'm sorry I upset you.
You're not boring, Aoi. I just thought I was being clever.
If you were really boring, I wouldn't be talking to you.
I make it myself. gotta venture into scaldraville to find the ingredients tho
I do love a silver lining ^_^
It seems the jury's convinced by your defense
Hey, that's not so bad. I hear Scaldraville's beautiful this time of year.
You must really like tea if you go to all that trouble.
And we don't even have to tell Amir.
and grants you a fresh start
a little side quest never hurts! err... rarely hurts.
knew I could count on u
oh yah nothing beats that efervon smell in the air
nothing will stop me from treating myself ^_^
thank goodness ur so good at keeping secrets
Oh, I see Aoi's emoticons are back. I think that's a good sign.
Looks like there was a little damage after all.
I think you'd better talk to Amir about fixing that.
I don't think typing is good for the keyboard at this point.
I'd ask if you're okay over there but... it looks like replying will be difficult either way.
Did Lettie's rats walk all over your keyboard or was that bubble tea damage?
I simply separated the metal in the keyboard from the liquid (and tapioca) then rebuilt it ^_^ good as new!
Wow you did that quickly too.
Damn, your powers are no joke.
I'm surprised you didn't think of that sooner.
yah sooo I'm totally gonna go brag to Amir
